title: phit
tagline: Regression, mixed models and probability distributions for PHP.
summary: phit is a PHP extension, written in Rust, for regression and mixed models, probability distributions and descriptive statistics. Models are written as R formulas (fit_ols, fit_generalized_linear, fit_mixed_gaussian, fit_mixed_logistic, predict), and results are plain PHP arrays.
requires: unzip or the PHP zip extension

verify.note: PHP-FPM reads its own php.ini, so enable the extension there and restart FPM.
